# Udruženje banaka Srbije (Association of Serbian Banks)

> > The Association of Serbian Banks (UBS-ASB) is Serbia's primary banking industry organization, coordinating banking sector activities, financial education programs, and regulatory collaboration with Narodna banka Srbije.

UBS-ASB represents major banks including Banca Intesa, Raiffeisen, AIK Bank, and Addiko Bank, operating through specialized committees and the Centar za bankarsku obuku (Banking Training Center). The association focuses on digital banking transformation, SEPA integration, trade finance, and financial literacy initiatives across Serbia.

## Key Topics

- Serbian Banking Sector
- Narodna banka Srbije (National Bank of Serbia)
- Digital Banking & SEPA Integration
- Financial Literacy & Education
- Banking Security & Fraud Prevention
- Trade & Finance Conferences
- Banking Training & Certification (ICA)
- Payment Systems & Open Banking
- ESG & Climate Risk in Banking
- Retail Banking Operations
- Banking Regulation & Compliance
- Banca Intesa, Raiffeisen, AIK Bank
- European Money Quiz
- BankInfo Conference Series

## Banking Sector Analysis & Core Operations

- [Analyses of the Banking Sector of Serbia](http://www.ubs-asb.com/en/banking-sector/analyses-of-the-banking-sector-of-serbia): Annual banking sector analysis reports & financial position data
- [Poslovi banaka sa stanovništvom](http://www.ubs-asb.com/o-nama/aktivnosti/poslovi-banaka-sa-stanovnistvom): Retail banking operations with Narodna banka Srbije & Ministry of Finance
- [Organizaciona šema](http://www.ubs-asb.com/sc/o-nama/nas-tim): Organizational structure & team directory with Marina Papadakis
- [Odbor za informatiku](http://www.ubs-asb.com/o-nama/strucni-odbori/odbor-za-informatiku): IT Committee members from Banca Intesa, OTP Banka & other banks
- [Payment System Committee](http://www.ubs-asb.com/en/about-us/expert-committees/payment-system-committee): Payment System Committee composition with Banca Intesa & member banks

## Banking Training & Professional Development

- [Program obuke](http://www.ubs-asb.com/o-nama/centar-za-bankarsku-obuku/program-obuke): Banking training programs with ICA certification & compliance courses
- [Liderske veštine u finansijskom sektoru](http://www.ubs-asb.com/dogadjaji/82-liderske-vestine-u-finansijskom-sektoru): Leadership skills webinar for financial sector professionals
- [Strategijsko upravljanje poslovanjem](http://www.ubs-asb.com/dogadjaji/106-strategijsko-upravljanje-poslovanjem-sinergija-ljudskog-kapitala-i-odrzive-transformacije-u-okruzenju-koje-se-menja): Strategic management conference on human capital & sustainable transformation

## Banking Security & Client Protection

- [Prevencija prevara](http://www.ubs-asb.com/korisnici-finansijskih-usluga/bezbednost-bankarskih-klijenata/prevencija-prevara): Fraud prevention guide covering phishing, skimming & identity theft
- [Internet bankarstvo](http://www.ubs-asb.com/korisnici-finansijskih-usluga/bezbednost-bankarskih-klijenata/internet-bankarstvo): Online banking security guide for Chrome, Internet Explorer users
